name: Summarise a short spoken account
short_description: Summarise a short spoken account once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can summarise a short spoken account in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Summarise a short spoken account means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Summarise a short spoken account in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Repeat a spoken instruction accurately helps develop summarise a short spoken account but is not indispensable.
Give a two-step spoken direction helps develop summarise a short spoken account but is not indispensable.
